scopes.expenses.card: View and manage card expenses data

UpdateExpenseRequest.description: The parameter for updating an expense.

receipt_name.description: The name of the receipt (with the file extension).

ReceiptUploadRequest.description: The parameter for creating a receipt upload.

receipt_name.description: The name of the receipt (with the file extension). It will be used in the matching result email.

ReceiptMatchRequest.description: The parameter for creating a receipt match.

download_uris.description: [Presigned S3 link](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)(s) to download file(s) of the receipt. Link(s) expire in 15 minutes.

id.description: The unique identifier for the receipt.

Receipt.description: The receipt associated with the expense.

Payment.description: The payment associated with the expense.

currency.description: The type of currency, in ISO 4217 format. Default to USD if not specified

amount.description: The amount of money, in the smallest denomination of the currency indicated by currency. For example, when currency is USD, amount is in cents.

Money.description:
Money fields can be signed or unsigned. Fields are signed (an unsigned value will be interpreted as positive). The amount of money will be represented in the smallest denomination
of the currency indicated. For example, USD 7.00 will be represented in cents with an amount of 700.

country.description: Merchant's country, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format.

mcc.description: A four-digit number listed in ISO 18245 for retail financial services, e.g. 4121 for Taxicabs and Rideshares. Please refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merchant_category_code for more details.

raw_descriptor.description: Merchant descriptor, it can be the merchant name.

id.description: The unique identifier for the location.

Location.description: The location associated with the expense.

billing_amount.description: The billing amount of the expense is the amount that the entity is charged, on the entity's currency, for reimbursements or card spends.

original_amount.description: The original amount of the expense is the amount that the employee submitted or incurred for reimbursements or card spends.

purchased_at.description: The time the purchase was made.

updated_at.description: The last time the expense was updated.

post.description:
The `uri` will be a pre-signed S3 URL allowing you to upload the receipt securely. This URL can only be used for a `PUT` operation and expires 30 minutes after its creation. Once your upload is complete, we will try to match the receipt with existing expenses.

Refer to these [docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/dev/PresignedUrlUploadObject.html) on how to upload to this pre-signed S3 URL. We highly recommend using one of AWS SDKs if they're available for your language to upload these files.

put.description: Update an expense. Admin and bookkeeper have access to any expense, and regular users can only access their own.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Get additional details for the expense, e.g. merchant mcc code, by passing in `expand[]=merchant`. Query parameters include `location`, `department`, `merchant`, `receipts.download_uris`, `user`, `budget` and `payment`.

parameters.name: load_custom_fields
parameters.description: Load custom fields for the expense.

get.description: Get an expense by its ID.

parameters.name: user_id[]
parameters.description: Get expenses belong to provided user(s).

parameters.name: parent_expense_id[]
parameters.description: Get itemized expenses belong to provided parent expenses ID(s).

parameters.name: purchased_at_start
parameters.description: Shows only expenses with a `purchased_at` on or after this date-time. This parameter is the date-time notation as defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6), e.g. 2022-11-12T23:59:59.999

parameters.name: purchased_at_end
parameters.description: Shows only expenses with a `purchased_at` on or before this date-time. This parameter is the date-time notation as defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6), e.g. 2022-11-12T23:59:59.999

parameters.name: load_custom_fields
parameters.description: Load custom fields for the expenses.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor to use for pagination. This is the `next_cursor` value returned from the previous response.

get.description: List expenses under the same account. Admin and bookkeeper have access to any expense, and regular users can only access their own.
